judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petitions with liberty to approach the concerned Magistrate, and seek necessary relief, pointing out the order passed by this Court in WP No. 16489 of 2026, dated 5-6-2026 (Vijayanand Srinivasan v. Punjab National Bank).

2. In view of the same, the writ petitions are dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty. There will be no order as to costs.
